run_benchmark_numpy: run the benchmark_numpy.py script to benchmark data loading speed across NPY, NPZ, and Torch formats
create_mock_data: create mock image and segmentation label data in NPY, NPZ, or Torch serialized format
load_npy_arrays: load numpy arrays from serialized NPY binary strings using numpy.load or spdl.io.load_npy
load_npz_arrays: load numpy arrays from serialized NPZ binary strings using numpy.load or spdl.io.load_npz
benchmark_config: configure a benchmark run with data format, compression, implementation, and worker count settings
